# discord_messages (Data Source)

Lists messages of a channel or thread, newest first. The bot needs the View Channel permission, and Connect in voice channels; without Read Message History, Discord returns no messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The 20 newest messages of a channel.
data "discord_messages" "recent" {
  channel_id = var.channel_id
  limit      = 20
}

# The messages around a message, including it.
data "discord_messages" "context" {
  channel_id = var.channel_id
  around     = var.message_id
  limit      = 5
}

output "recent_authors" {
  value = toset(data.discord_messages.recent.messages[*].author_id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel or thread.

### Optional

- `after` (String) Return the messages after this message ID. Conflicts with the other two of `around`, `before` and `after`.
- `around` (String) Return the messages around this message ID, including it. Conflicts with the other two of `around`, `before` and `after`.
- `before` (String) Return the messages before this message ID. Conflicts with the other two of `around`, `before` and `after`.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to 50. Discord returns at most 100 per request, so higher limits take several requests; with `around`, the limit is at most 100.

### Read-Only

- `messages` (Attributes List) Messages, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messages))

<a id="nestedatt--messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messages`

Read-Only:

- `author_id` (String) ID of the author.
- `author_username` (String) Username of the author.
- `content` (String) Text content. Empty unless the bot has the Message Content privileged intent or wrote the message.
- `edited_timestamp` (String) When the message was last edited, or null.
- `flags` (Number) [Message flags](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message#message-object-message-flags) bitfield.
- `id` (String) Message ID.
- `pinned` (Boolean) Whether the message is pinned.
- `timestamp` (String) When the message was sent.
- `type` (Number) [Message type](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message#message-object-message-types), `0` for a default message.
- `webhook_id` (String) ID of the webhook that sent the message, if any.
